take_rate.label: Marketplace commission on item revenue
take_rate.note: Olist's commission and fees are not in the dataset. 10% is an illustrative value for a marketplace take rate; change it in the dashboard's simulation pages.

payment_cost_rate.label: Payment processing cost as a share of payment value
payment_cost_rate.note: Not in the dataset; illustrative card/boleto processing cost.

metrics.name: item_revenue
metrics.label: Item revenue
metrics.definition: Sum of item prices on valid orders. Excludes freight.

metrics.name: freight_value
metrics.label: Freight charged
metrics.definition: Sum of freight charged to customers on valid orders. Not Olist revenue.

metrics.name: gmv
metrics.label: GMV
metrics.definition: Gross merchandise value = item revenue + freight, on valid orders.
metrics.caveats: Before returns and refunds, which the dataset does not record.

metrics.name: payment_value
metrics.label: Payment value
metrics.definition: Sum of payments recorded on valid orders (cash charged to customers).
metrics.caveats: Differs from GMV on a few hundred orders (instalment interest, vouchers, rounding); it is not revenue.

metrics.name: aov
metrics.label: Average order value
metrics.definition: GMV / valid orders.

metrics.name: freight_share_of_gmv
metrics.label: Freight share of GMV
metrics.definition: Freight charged / GMV.

metrics.name: gmv_mom_growth
metrics.label: GMV growth, last month vs previous
metrics.definition: GMV of the last complete month in the selection / GMV of the month before - 1.
metrics.caveats: Month-on-month growth is noisy; read it with the 3-month average in SQL 01.

sql.query: WITH m AS (SELECT purchase_month, SUM(gmv) AS gmv FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 GROUP BY purchase_month) SELECT (SELECT gmv FROM m ORDER BY purchase_month DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT gmv FROM m ORDER BY purchase_month DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) - 1 AS value

metrics.name: marketplace_revenue_estimate
metrics.label: Marketplace revenue (estimate)
metrics.definition: take_rate x item revenue. An estimate of Olist's own revenue.
metrics.caveats: The dataset has no commission data; the take rate is an assumption.

metrics.name: contribution_estimate
metrics.label: Contribution (estimate)
metrics.definition: Marketplace revenue estimate - payment_cost_rate x payment value. A rough profit proxy before fixed costs, marketing and any shipping subsidy.
metrics.caveats: Built only from assumptions applied to observed volumes; not observed profit.

metrics.name: orders
metrics.label: Orders
metrics.definition: Number of valid orders.

metrics.name: orders_placed
metrics.label: Orders placed
metrics.definition: All orders, including cancelled and unavailable ones.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate
metrics.label: Cancellation rate
metrics.definition: Orders with status canceled or unavailable / orders placed.

metrics.name: delivery_completion_rate
metrics.label: Delivery completion
metrics.definition: Delivered orders / orders placed.
metrics.caveats: Orders placed near the end of the extract may still be in transit.

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: Items per order
metrics.definition: Items sold / valid orders.

metrics.name: credit_card_share
metrics.label: Orders paid mainly by credit card
metrics.definition: Valid orders whose largest payment is by credit card / valid orders with a payment.

sql.expr: AVG(CASE WHEN main_payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
sql.where: is_valid = 1 AND main_payment_type IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: avg_installments
metrics.label: Average instalments
metrics.definition: Mean of the largest instalment count per valid order.

metrics.name: customers
metrics.label: Customers
metrics.definition: Distinct people (customer_unique_id) with at least one valid order.

metrics.name: new_customers
metrics.label: New customers
metrics.definition: People whose first valid order ever falls in the selection.

metrics.name: returning_customers
metrics.label: Returning customers
metrics.definition: People with a second or later valid order in the selection.

metrics.name: repeat_rate
metrics.label: Repeat-customer rate
metrics.definition: Of the people acquired in the selection (first valid order in it), the share whose second valid order is also in the selection.
metrics.caveats: Customers acquired late have had less time to return (right-censoring).

sql.query:
SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(s.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM fct_orders AS f LEFT JOIN fct_orders AS s
  ON s.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id AND s.customer_order_seq = 2
WHERE f.is_valid = 1 AND f.customer_order_seq = 1

metrics.name: gmv_per_customer
metrics.label: GMV per customer (observed)
metrics.definition: GMV / customers in the selection. Observed historical value, not a forecast.

metrics.name: orders_per_customer
metrics.label: Orders per customer
metrics.definition: Valid orders / customers.

metrics.name: avg_delivery_days
metrics.label: Average delivery time
metrics.definition: Mean calendar days from purchase to delivery, delivered valid orders.

metrics.name: avg_promised_days
metrics.label: Average promised time
metrics.definition: Mean days from purchase to the estimated date shown at checkout, delivered orders.

metrics.name: late_rate
metrics.label: Late deliveries
metrics.definition: Delivered valid orders that arrived after the estimated date / delivered valid orders.

metrics.name: avg_days_late_when_late
metrics.label: Days late when late
metrics.definition: Mean days after the estimated date, over late orders only.

metrics.name: avg_review
metrics.label: Average review
metrics.definition: Mean review score (1-5) of valid orders with a review (orders with several reviews use their mean).

sql.where: is_valid = 1 AND review_score IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: bad_review_rate
metrics.label: 1-2 star reviews
metrics.definition: Share of reviewed valid orders with a mean score of 2 or less.

sql.expr: AVG(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
sql.where: is_valid = 1 AND review_score IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: review_gap_late
metrics.label: Review gap, on time minus late
metrics.definition: Mean review of on-time delivered orders minus mean review of late ones.
metrics.caveats: An association in observational data, not the causal effect of lateness.

sql.query:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN is_late = 0 THEN review_score END)
  - AVG(CASE WHEN is_late = 1 THEN review_score END) AS value
FROM fct_orders WHERE is_valid = 1 AND is_delivered = 1 AND review_score IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: active_categories
metrics.label: Categories sold
metrics.definition: Distinct product categories with at least one item on a valid order.

metrics.name: active_sellers
metrics.label: Active sellers
metrics.definition: Distinct sellers with at least one item on a valid order.

metrics.name: item_revenue_per_seller
metrics.label: Item revenue per active seller
metrics.definition: Item revenue / active sellers.
